hook.from: Geography > Location, Terrain, Natural resources; Economy > Exports
hook.excerpt: Central Asia, bordering the Caspian Sea, between Iran and Kazakhstan || flat-to-rolling sandy desert with dunes rising to mountains in the south; low mountains along border with Iran; borders Caspian Sea in west || landlocked; the western and central low-lying desolate portions of the country make up the great Garagum (Kara-Kum) desert, which occupies over 80% of the country; eastern part is plateau || Resources: petroleum, natural gas, sulfur, salt || Exports: natural gas, refined petroleum, fertilizers, crude petroleum, electricity (2023)

physicalGeography.excerpt: flat-to-rolling sandy desert with dunes rising to mountains in the south; low mountains along border with Iran; borders Caspian Sea in west || Central Asia, bordering the Caspian Sea, between Iran and Kazakhstan

climate.excerpt: subtropical desert || earthquakes; mudslides; droughts; dust storms; floods

economy.excerpt: upper-middle-income Central Asian economy; houses fourth-largest natural gas reserves and rich in natural resources; authoritarian and dominated by state-owned enterprises; challenges include overvalued currency, high inflation risks, lack of economic diversification due to heavy state control and bureaucracy || Exports: natural gas, refined petroleum, fertilizers, crude petroleum, electricity (2023) || Industries: natural gas, oil, petroleum products, textiles, food processing
